Now knocks back enemies within range.

lines_en: Replaced with Predatory Instincts - Ofuda travel 50% faster when seeking enemies below half health.

timeline.text_en: Clone Damage and Healing reduced to 75% less (down from 65% less).

Reworked from "After reloading, your next 3 [Kunai] explode on contact, dealing 20 damage to nearby enemies" to "After using an ability or gadget, your next 3 [Kunai] explode on contact, dealing 20 damage to nearby enemies".
Removed Increased Cooldown if Swift Step with no target.
Added "Range is reduced by 50% when used without a target."
Kunai hits launch 3 [Healing Ofuda] to an ally in front of you.
Added "After using [Kitsune Rush], refresh all other ability cooldowns."

Kunai hits launch 2 Healing Ofuda to an ally in front of you.

Damaging enemies farther than 12 meters now reveals them for 5 seconds, previously 3 seconds.

Kiriko can jump an extra time in the air

Now heals for an additional 30 health when cleansing a negative effect.
Recovery time reduced from 0.55 to 0.5 seconds.
Critical damage multiplier reduced from 3 to 2.5x.
Kunai reloads after 65% percent of the animation has completed (formerly 75%)
New Hero option: "Healing Ofuda Cancels Reload"
Healing Ofuda Cancels Reload - On by default
Recovery time increased from 0.85 to 1 second
